notes.title: ARMS DOLL V2.0f
notes.content:
We have updated ARMS DOLL to V2.0f.

The update includes the following changes:

・Fixed a bug where obtaining certain achievements would also unlock unrelated achievements
・Fixed a bug where the game options for the rising input threshold and the rapid descent input threshold were applied in reverse
・Adjusted the sensitivity of turning operations in the garage, which was too sensitive

Thank you for your continued support of ARMS DOLL.

notes.title: ARMS DOLL V2.0
notes.content:
We have updated ARMS DOLL to V2.0!

Major updates include the remake of all models of mechs and weapons, the revision of various effects, the addition of mission summaries and AD dictionaries, and the addition of movement within bases.

In addition, we have made the following corrections:

・During missions or in game options, you can adjust the position of the lever
・Added a forced Quest mode to game options (please try this if your hand orientation is incorrect when playing with VirtualDesktop in Quest etc.)

Thank you for your continued support of “ARMS DOLL”!

notes.title: ARMS DOLL v1.1f
notes.content:
I have updated ARMS DOLL to v1.1f. The changes in this update are as follows:

・Fixed a bug where the game would crash when launched on Oculus/Meta headsets.

Thank you for your continued support of "ARMS DOLL".

notes.title: ARMS DOLL v1.1
notes.content:
We have updated ARMS DOLL to v1.1. The update includes the following changes:

・Added a new diving feature. 
  During boost activation, players can quickly descend the machine by tilting the lever downwards.

・Removed the "Game Setting 2" option and merged it into the "Game Setting" option, which now allows players to switch between pages. Also, we have added the following options to the game settings:
- LEVER UP THRESHOLD
- LEVER DOWN THRESHOLD
When players perform actions with an input angle exceeding the set threshold, the machine will ascend or dive accordingly.

・Adjusted the AI of some enemies to accommodate the new diving feature.

・Changed the display when players grip the lever to show a translucent hand at the controller position.

・Adjusted the camera controls during stick or pad operation to allow for up-down camera movement using only one side of the stick.

・Added stationary targets to the weapon use tutorial at the end of the tutorial.

Thank you for your continued support of "ARMS DOLL."

notes.title: ARMS DOLL v1.03
notes.content:
ARMS DOLL has been updated to v1.03.
The updated points are as follows.

The following settings have been added to the "GAME OPTION 2" item in the Options.
 - Hand angle adjustment
 - Camera control type (lever twist/stick (Index, Quest, etc.) or pad (Vive, etc.) / none)
 - Lever Auto Reset (if set to ON, the lever will return to its initial state when released)

Homing performance of some weapons has been adjusted.
 - SMALLBOX ML
 - MATCHBOX ML
 - SLD MISSILE LAUNCHER (NIGHTFLYER)
 
Thank you for your continued support of "ARMS DOLL".

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that sometimes caused melee attacks to hit in the middle of nowhere when there is an enemy who attacks in melee.

Thank you for your continued support of "ARMS DOLL".

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed

Achievements could not be obtained.
(Achievements that have not been acquired even though the conditions have been met will be acquired at the start of the game.)

An issue that prevented the user from paging through the store's weapon sales and weapon enhancement screens when the number of weapons is large.

An issue where the bullet speed and reload speed of melee weapons could be enhanced.
(If you have already enhanced a weapon, you can sell it and purchase it again to recover the enhancement funds.)

Thank you for your continued support of the "ARMS DOLL".

notes.title: Fixed operation with Oculus and Quest2
notes.content:
We have officially updated the fixes we recently made in the beta version for operation with Oculus and Quest2.

Thank you for your continued support of ARMS DOLL.

notes.title: Beta for Oculus & Quest2
notes.content:
We have received feedback that it is difficult to control the game with quest2, so we have uploaded a fixed version as a beta version.
We would like to update the game officially if there are no problems.
The beta version can be selected from the properties of the game management.

If you have any problems, please let us know via Twitter (@tsujigirimumyou) or email (tsujigirimumyou@yahoo.co.jp).

notes.title: ARMS DOLL Release!
notes.content:
Today, September 30, 2022, we released the VR mecha action game "ARMS DOLL"!
We apologize for the delay in the release and the inconvenience it caused to those who were looking forward to the game and to the media who published our press release.

notes.title: Apology
notes.content:
Sorry!
It's now the scheduled release time, and as of right now we still can't release it!
We thought all the procedures had been completed, but we are now inquiring with STEAM as to the cause.
